title: Children and Baby Posing on Boulders, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An endearing Great Depression-era snapshot of three siblings resting outdoors among large granite boulders in a sun-dappled forest. A seated young boy holds a cheerful infant upright on a rock, while an older sister sporting a short bob hairstyle and rolled denim overalls stands barefoot with her hands resting casually in her pockets. The back features album corner mounting remnants and a stamped photo laboratory number.
